visual_brief.subject: Devin moves Playbooks to Skills
verified_context: Devin is replacing Playbooks with Skills as its reusable instruction format.
Existing Playbooks are converted into Skills with the same instructions, while the former Playbooks pages become read-only.
Devin says existing Playbooks API integrations, @playbook mentions and !playbook macros continue to work during the migration.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A familiar body of procedural knowledge passes through a controlled transition and becomes a more modular durable form without losing its contents.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A stack of unmarked paper instruction cards passes through one substantial brass-and-stone conversion portal and emerges as an orderly set of modular paper tiles, with the same terracotta thread visibly continuing through both sides.
must_show: paper instruction cards before the portal
modular paper tiles after the portal

candidate_notes.A: The conversion reads clearly and the continuous thread is strong, but the distant landscape and large circular portal drift away from the quieter paper-and-tool materiality of the golden references.
candidate_notes.B: Selected: the folio, brass hinge and separate paper modules form one continuous tactile artifact; the terracotta thread preserves the content metaphor and the silhouette remains clear at small size.
candidate_notes.C: The fitted niches give the modular output convincing physical presence, but the apparatus feels more industrial and the bundle-to-module transition is less immediate in a centered mobile crop.

crop_review.article_desktop: The open folio, brass hinge, paper modules and continuous thread remain visible across the full 16:9 crop.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the hinge and enough of both the bound and modular forms to preserve the transformation.
crop_review.thumbnail: At 320 pixels wide, the bound folio and fanned modules remain distinct and the terracotta thread still links them.

golden_reference_comparison: Compared directly with the two declared developer-tooling references for warm paper materiality, restrained terracotta, physical depth, compositional confidence and thumbnail silhouette. Candidate B best matches the archive while using a distinct story-specific artifact.

generation_metadata.visual_review: Three materially distinct candidates were generated and inspected at full size, beside the golden references, at 320-pixel thumbnail scale and in a centered mobile cover crop. Candidate B passed the constitutional, prohibited-element and responsive-crop review through Codex model self-review.
